name: The Gate of the South
reading: Giovanni's town is the southern garrison, and its gym is the gate: 'for seven badges it is the building everyone walks past, and for the eighth it is the one you have to go through to leave' (data/placements.json gym8_town plan.reading). So the building is not a hall, it is a gatehouse - a walled muster yard open to the sky, with a gate mass seven wide and eight high filling its west end, sheer on the yard side, no opening in it at any height, and the walk on top of it where Giovanni stands looking down the road to Victory Road. He is a ground type and the garrison is under siege from the Rift, so the way past a shut gate is the way a garrison actually takes it: down the sap, along the counter-mine, into the undercroft, and up the gate's own inner stair. You go under the gate to get on top of it. The palette is the town's own: terracotta, polished granite, spruce, coarse dirt, mud brick for the sandbags (docs/world-building/TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym8_town).

site.lot_source: data/placements.json settlements.gym8_town.plan.anchors gym8_gym (rect [3556,6400,3588,6432], level 112, facing east). The plan's prep_note: 'the gym's lot, below the square to the north-west, is levelled to the square.' tools/place_town.py cuts and fills a levelled lot to its level, so the pad is y112 - the same y as the gate square's own paving.

ground.why: the pad is the ground. The raw heightmap over the lot rect runs y110 to y112 (tools/ground.py, rounded, measured for this record: min 110, max 112) and the prep levels it to 112, the top of that range and the square's y - a small fill and no real cut, which is what the prep_note says. Neither number was read from a world save (the ground rule, tests/test_ground_rule.py).

site.footprint_size_why: 25 by 25 inside a 33x33 lot: margins 4 west, 4 east, 4 north, 4 south. There is no roof and no eaves overhang - a garrison yard is open to the sky - so the written extent never leaves x3559-3585 z6403-6429 and the lot's whole perimeter, where a player arrives from the gate square, is untouched pad at y112.

bounds_why: the gatehouse (3560..3584 x 6404..6428) with one cell of working room round it, up to y128 for the curtain wall at y122 and the two air cells over Giovanni at y123, and DOWN TO y104 for the nine courses of rock this function lays under the pad and then cuts the mine out of. Inside the lot rect [3556,6400,3588,6432] with a margin of three on every side, AND inside the gym_giovanni spawn-free box on every side - the box, not the lot, is what binds the south edge.

leader.name: Giovanni
leader.why: kanto_giovanni is the upstream Radical Cobblemon Trainers id and it is load-bearing: a persistent leader trainer anywhere awards the badge (verified on staging 2026-09-24, docs/STATE.md). EXP-013 E2 (VERIFIED, on staging): a bare rctmod:trainer_spawner set by command with TrainerIds on a redstone block spawned the leader and he battled. The donor shell's own spawner goes with the shell in this function's clearing fill, so this is the only kanto_giovanni in the town and the eighth badge cannot be won without going under the gate and coming up inside it.

rooms.why: the muster yard: sixteen by twenty-three of polished granite paving at y112, walked at y113, open to the sky, closed by ten courses of curtain wall on three sides and by the gate mass on the fourth. Three well heads are cut in its floor and two of them are one course deep.

the sap and the counter-mine: a shaft three by three from the yard's paving down to y107, and a drift eleven long on a coarse-dirt floor at y106, with three headings driven south off it. Two of the three are two cells and a face.
the chamber the counter-mine was driven to reach, ten by five under the gate mass itself, floor y106 and walked at y107. The foot of the gate's own stair is in its north-west corner.

the gate's inner stair: a slot two wide cut up through the gate mass, fourteen courses from the undercroft at y107 to the gate walk at y121, each step closed above by the rock of the step in front of it.

the walk on top of the gate, seven by twenty-three at y121, eight courses over the yard, with the curtain wall standing two higher on three sides and an open drop into the yard on the fourth. Giovanni stands on it facing the road north.

route.why: the yard has one gate and no stair. Three well heads are cut in its paving: two cisterns, one course deep, and the sap, which goes down six to the counter-mine. The sap alone carries a spruce headframe and a lamp, and that is the tell - a thing in the world, the same for every player. A ladder[facing=south] runs y107 to y112 in the shaft's north-west column, carried the whole way by the rock at (3577,y,6406). Stepping into the shaft head catches the ladder for nothing; stepping into any other column of it is a six-block fall onto the drift's floor for three damage. Both waypoints are standing cells: (3576,113,6415) is yard paving with the course at y112 under it, (3577,107,6408) is the drift with its coarse-dirt floor at y106.
route.not_skippable: the curtain wall stands ten courses to y122 on three sides and the gate mass eight courses to y120 on the fourth, and neither has an opening above the yard's own gate at y113-115. The yard's furniture - two sandbag lines one course high, three palisade stakes two courses high, crates, a spoil heap - tops out at y114, so a player's feet reach y115 at best and the lowest thing to climb to is six courses further up. The two cisterns are floored one course down by the rock this function lays under the pad. The sap is the only cell in the yard with anything under it.

route.why: the drift runs eleven cells west from the sap's foot and three headings are driven south off it at x3576, x3572 and x3569. All three are one wide and two high and look the same at the mouth; two run two cells and stop at the face. The west one runs twelve to the undercroft, and it is the only one that is shored - a stripped-spruce crown down its whole ceiling course at y109 with three glowstones set into it, where the other two have bare stone. Both waypoints are standing cells on a coarse-dirt floor at y106.
route.not_skippable: the drift, the headings and the undercroft are cut out of the nine courses of rock this function lays under the pad, so every wall and ceiling underground is solid stone and there is no cell open below y113 that this record did not cut. The drift itself ends at a face at x3568. Nothing reaches the undercroft but the west heading.

route.why: the gate's own inner stair leaves the undercroft's north-west corner and climbs fourteen courses inside the gate mass, two wide, from a step topping at y107 at z6421 to one topping at y120 at z6408. Each course is a one-block rise with three courses cut open over it, so a player's head is clear the whole way and no drop in the slot is longer than one block. Both waypoints are standing cells: (3565,107,6423) is the undercroft floor, (3562,121,6408) is the stair's head with the last step's top block at y120 under it.
route.not_skippable: the stair is a slot cut through eight courses of solid granite and six of rock. Its foot is in the undercroft and its head is on the gate walk, and it touches nothing else: the counter-mine passes nowhere near it, and the yard is on the other side of the mass.

route.why: the stair's head opens east onto the walk. The walk's own parapet stands two courses along the well's east side from z6409 south, so a player cannot fall back into the slot - and it deliberately does not stand at z6408, which is the cell the stair arrives at. Giovanni is eight cells south at (3565,121,6416) on a redstone block set into the walk's course, with his chest four cells north of him. (3564,121,6416) is the standing cell beside him.

the way back, and the reason the walk is not a trap (GYM_BUILDINGS_REVIEW D8: Blaine's vault had no exit at all and 192 positions could not regain the lot). The walk's east edge is open over the yard: an eight-block drop from y121 onto the paving at y112, landing with the feet at y113 for five damage - inside data/gym_interiors.json rules.max_fall of 12 and inside the ten damage a route may cost, so it needs no hay and none is used anywhere in this gym. The stair is the other way down. Eight courses is also why the drop is not a way UP: nothing in the yard reaches past y115.

trainers_why: none authored, exactly as gyms 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7. A gym trainer has to be unavoidable, and unavoidability is a claim about where a player can physically stand and how far a trainer can see - the independent movement model settles that, and it is not this unit's to write (CLAUDE.md principle 16). The `trainers` array is supported by the generator and lands in derived/gym_buildings/trainer_seats.json for trainer-balance-designer. The four places that would hold one are the yard inside the gate, the drift's mouth at the sap's foot, the undercroft, and the walk at the stair's head.

no_build.why: the whole gatehouse and the ground under it. Authored, not wired: the scene runtime's adventure-mode box (tools/scenes_pack.py no_build) needs a scene record in data/scenes.json and that is not written in this unit. Until it is, a player with blocks can pillar eight courses out of the yard straight onto the gate walk and skip the sap, the mine and the stair together.

spawn_suppression.note: data/spawn_suppression.json gym_giovanni, UNCHANGED, and this building lies wholly inside it. That is by construction and it bound the footprint: the box's south edge is z6431 while the gym lot runs south to z6432, so the lot's southernmost row is NOT covered and nothing is built on it. Every written cell of this record lies in x3559-3585 (inside 3552-3591) and z6403-6429 (inside 6400-6431). The box is already whole 8-blocks - 3552/8=444, 6400/8=800, 3592/8=449, 6432/8=804 - so tools/suppress_inherited_spawns.py does not fail closed on it and no change to data/spawn_suppression.json is needed for this gym. It matters more here than at gym 6: the yard and the gate walk are OPEN TO THE SKY, which is where a wild Pokemon would otherwise stand. No block this record places is named in data/spawn_blocks.json.

blocks_why: the town's own palette (docs/world-building/TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym8_town: terracotta, polished granite, spruce, coarse dirt; mud brick for the sandbags) plus the lamp the town plan already names for this settlement (minecraft:glowstone, 'a plain warm light set flush into the earth streets; not a spawn condition'). There is NO water and NO lava in this gym, so no source can leak and nothing can drown; no leaves, so nothing decays; no sand or gravel, so nothing falls into a passage it was not meant to close; no soul sand, so there is no bubble column to prove; no rails, fences, walls or slabs anywhere, so no cell reads as solid that a player expects to walk through; and no lanterns and no chains - every light in the building is a glowstone let flush into a floor, a ceiling or a beam, which is a full block and cannot pop. Thirty-one lanterns stood in mid air across the five interiors this work replaces.
